services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: If you would like to have one of our current exhibitions to travel to your museum, school, or gallery, contact our curator at curator@melegaartmuseum.org After a very successful run at the Melega, “The Working Press - Moments in Time” exhibition moves on to Penn State Fayette, The Eberly Campus. Bobby Salitrik, guest curator, conceived the show’s theme and has chosen the photographers. An outstanding example of our Traveling Exhibition was on view at Penn State Fayette, The Eberly Campus. The exhibition was part two of Daniel R. Salitrik’s 2006 Artist of the Pike Exhibition. The show opened November 17th and was on display in the Williams Building gallery until the end of January, 2007. We

blurb: Fans of Antonio Petruccelli from around the world will now have a chance to own a limited edition of some of the artist’s most engaging artworks. Six different illustrations from the exhibit “Antonio Petruccelli: Master Illustrator” have been chosen. Limited editions are now available for sale at the Frank L. Melega Art Museum sales gallery and here online at the museum’s website.
